A ranking per discipline, by adoption and enterprise footprint, with the
situation where each tool is the best choice
classic models: tracking, registry, pipelines, monitoring
the default for tracking & registry; managed in Databricks, Azure ML, SageMaker
lakehouse shops: data, features, training and serving in one place
SageMaker AI / Vertex AI / Azure ML
experiment tracking for deep-learning teams; now part of CoreWeave
pipelines on Kubernetes or an existing scheduler
drift and performance monitoring in production
apps on foundation models: tracing, evals, prompts, cost
LangChain / LangGraph teams; cloud, hybrid or self-hosted
most used open-source option; self-host for EU data; part of ClickHouse
OTel-native tracing and evals; strong where classic ML also lives
extend the MLOps tool you already have
eval and red-team tests in CI
building and running your own models
Kubernetes control plane & KV-cache-aware routing over vLLM
distributed training, tuning and batch inference
LoRA / QLoRA fine-tuning on few GPUs
agents in production: multi-step traces, tool calls, agent evals
LangGraph agents: tracing plus agent deployment
agents on Azure: agent evaluators (tool-call accuracy, task completion), App Insights
agents on AWS: OTel traces and CloudWatch dashboards
one pane for agents, APIs and infrastructure
open-source agent tracing you can self-host
lightweight SDK for agent sessions; small next to the above
How to read it: rank = adoption signals (PyPI / npm downloads Sep–Oct 2026, GitHub stars) plus
enterprise footprint; tied tools share a row.
* Downloads are inflated by dependencies: langsmith ships with LangChain. Neptune.ai was acquired by
OpenAI, so plan migrations off it.
There is no single winner: pick the tool that lives where your data, cloud and frameworks already are, and
keep traces in OpenTelemetry so you can switch.
free to self-host; hosted cloud with a free tier
free tier, paid plans to scale
open-source core, paid enterprise or managed edition
usage-based subscription after a free trial
Pricing models as of October 2026; check each vendor for current tiers.
